title: What the Hand Knows
logline: A dyer carries a length of cloth between shade, doorway and full sun before deciding a colour is right, while an apprentice waits for the verdict.
human_question: If the same cloth is a different colour in every light, which colour is the one being sold?

situation.what_happens: A small workshop takes an order for cloth in a particular colour. The dye is mixed from samples and memory, the cloth is worked, and then the colour has to be judged, which means carrying it from shade to doorway to full sun and back, holding it against a sample, and deciding. Whoever is learning the trade often disagrees, and so sometimes does the customer. The question cannot be settled by measurement. It is settled by someone saying so, and by whether the customer accepts it.
situation.who_is_involved: The dyer whose name the work carries; an apprentice or family member learning to see; the customer who ordered a colour and remembers it their own way.
situation.what_is_at_stake: The order, the cost of dyeing again, and a reputation for being able to match a colour. For the apprentice, whether a judgement that lives entirely in someone else's eye can be handed on at all.
situation.how_it_unfolds: Work like this runs from an agreed sample to a finished length with a verdict in between. The pressures are daylight, time and the customer's memory. It ends in acceptance, a reworking, or a sale at a lower price. The customer decides which, not the film.

concept_merge.why_together: C065 contributes what the eye actually receives: never the object, but an image carried by light, always a blend of countless tiny colours that shifts with distance and lighting. C067 contributes the pair that makes this sharp, that of all twenty-eight kinds of matter only colour is visible at all. Together they describe a trade conducted entirely through the one visible channel, on information that is never the same twice.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: A dyer's day shows that the sources' claim is not sceptical but practical. Nobody is deceived; everybody is simply working with a narrow and shifting channel, and the disagreement between two people looking at one cloth is not a failure of attention. It is what the sources say should be expected.

concept_links.why: The digest states that of all twenty-eight kinds of matter only colour can be seen, that what reaches the eye is described as an image carried by light, and that it is always a blend of countless tiny colours shifting with distance and light, so the 'true colour' is never received, and two people looking at the same cloth do not receive quite the same thing. The digest is explicit that this account is the author's own explanatory model and must not be presented as optics.
The digest's visible and invisible pair singles out colour as the one visible kind among twenty-eight, which is precisely the narrow channel a dyer's whole livelihood runs through.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: Of everything these texts count as matter, only colour can be seen at all, and even that arrives as a blend that shifts with the light, which is why two people looking at one cloth do not quite receive the same thing.
what_must_be_real: The workshop's own commissions and real judgement calls. No moment of decision staged or relit, and no claim that the texts anticipated optics.
position_hint: middle: it belongs beside the group's other films about what a single sense actually receives, but its substance is carried into the eye-camp film rather than holding a slot of its own.
risks: A pretty colour montage with no stake in it.
Relighting or repeating the judgement for the camera.
Reading the source's image-carried-by-light model as early science.
drop_if: No real commission to follow in the research window.
No workshop willing to be filmed disagreeing, rather than only working.

connections.note: Its concept work, colour as the only visible kind of matter and never received as itself, now sits inside IDEA-0124.
Two senses under pressure: colour lost to shifting light, sound lost to wind.

selection.reason: Folded into IDEA-0124, which holds the group's slot on what the eye receives and now carries C065 and the never-the-true-colour material.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
